description: This script is a shell test suite for testing the 'subtree' merge strategy in Git. It sets up multiple repositories and branches, performs various merge operations, and verifies the results to ensure the correctness of the subtree merge functionality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A method to define a successful test case with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: A method to write lines to a file within the test, used for setting up file contents.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: A method to compare the contents of two files or outputs, used for verification.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: A method to assert that a specific path is a file, used to verify presence of files after operations.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: A method to create a commit, possibly with a specified message, in the repository.
